events.title: VERISMO Demo Update 1
events.summary: Small fixes before Next Fest; if there are any unforeseen issues, I can revert back a build.Fixed a softlock bug in the carnivalTweaked a few sprite in cutscenes to make them more engagingAdded a hide mouse plugin to keep cursor invisible during gameplayMade a couple next steps in scenes more clearFixed some flickering sprites / unresponsive from certain anglesSome typosAdded "Prologue" and "Act I" markers to the game

events.title: VERISMO: Final Demo LIVE
events.summary: The final demo of VERISMO is here!After 2.5 years of total work, here's what's all new compared to the old 15 minute prologue:An extra hour of playtime! Explore a night carnival and Sicilian town, and get to meet an intriguing cast of characters, some seedier than others...An all-new soundtrack of authentic, early 1900s recordings, recreated by a freelance musician and lovingly rearranged to leitmotif perfection by yours truly. Oh, and there's lots of opera references too.Revamped, polished UINe

events.title: VERISMO playtest is LIVE!
events.summary: You can check out the first full demo version of VERISMO now, on the store page!!It's missing some cutscenes and artwork, but that'll be patched in this weekend as I finish everything.If you have any thoughts or critique on the demo so far I'd love to hear it in the Steam discussions. This is the first time I'm showcasing all of the demo as a playable build, so I'm pretty anxious for any feedback.

events.title: 1k Wishlists + Demo Update
events.summary: "We'll live in Dreamland night and day."After slow and steady progress, VERISMO has surpassed 1,000 wishlists!I was going to wait to make this post until June, which is the 2-ish year anniversary since I started working on VERISMO, but I figured this is a good enough excuse to celebrate early and share some updates.By random chance, an old meme animation I made 3 years ago got picked up by the Youtube algorithm (you can find the youtube link on the main store page), and I seized the opportunity

events.title: Updated Key Rebinding
events.summary: A small update to remove the plugin I was using for key rebinding. I wanted to include AZERTY keyboard options but since default controls are either WASD or arrow keys, I figured it's a fine compromise for now. Proper key rebinding options will be supported in the future.It was removed because it was strange to be stuck with only Z to confirm on the main menu. Now:"Z", "Enter" or "Space" to confirmWASD or arrow keys to move
